title: Design: Part created and linked message looks as in the design
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations: the test location and location B.
  • Create part A for this test at location B only, so its Part Library entry exists and the test location does not stock it.
  • Write down part A's part number and description.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 1.4 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Inventory Part.
  2. Type a description that differs from part A's description in the Description box.
  3. Type part A's part number, exactly as at location B, in the Part Number box.
  4. Pick any category in the Category box.
  5. Type 1 in the Cost box.
  6. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Inventory Part window opens.

Step 2:

  • The Description box shows the typed description.

Step 3:

  • The Part Number box shows part A's part number.

Step 4:

  • The Category box shows the picked category.

Step 5:

  • The Cost box shows "$ 1".

Step 6:

  • The window closes and the list shows behind a green message box with a white tick-in-a-circle icon at its left and "Close" at its right.
  • The message box sits at the bottom right of the page.
  • The message wraps over up to three lines and reads: Part created. Linked to (part A's part number) in the Part Library. Its description "(part A's description)" was kept.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description)

  • S7-R9: “When the part was linked to an existing entry whose description differs from the one typed, ignoring upper and lower case and spaces before and after, the system shows "Part created. Linked to {part number} in the Part Library. Its description "{library description}" was kept." For example: "Part created. Linked to N68SL-356 in the Part Library. Its description "BRAKE PAD" was kept."”
  • User Feedback Summary: “New part linked to an entry whose description differs | "Part created. Linked to {part number} in the Part Library. Its description "{library description}" was kept." | Success toast, fades on its own”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: board "1.4 Saved and linked to the Part Library entry". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above where the PRD speaks, and from the board pictures where it is silent about the look.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • create-04-p1-4-linked-toast.png

The design's own words:

  • “Exactly one Part Library entry has the number typed, so the new part links to it (S7-R4, S7-R5). The entry keeps its own description (S7-R6). The descriptions differ, so the toast reads: "Part created. Linked to F40010212 in the Part Library. Its description "Slack Adjuster" was kept." (S7-R9). There is no toast when they match, or when a new entry is created (S7-R10).”
